findings.recommendation: Operator-judgment: consider throttling tinker to every-other-day (0 3 */2 * *) during sustained quiet periods, saving ~$6.4/day (~$90/14d).
findings.counter_argument: The daily backlog-trend computation (PROP-030) is tinker most valuable early-warning instrument — it exists precisely because three Mode-1 runs missed a growing backlog. Halving tinker frequency halves queue-history.jsonl granularity and the PROP-102/108 shadow-walk cadence. The trend compute is cheap (cents of the $12.77); the Opus deep-work is the cost. A cleaner (but larger) fix would split a cheap daily trend-only check from every-other-day deep Mode-3 work — PROP territory, not a simple schedule flip. Net: low-risk to throttle given open_issues=3 stable, but it does weaken a watchdog by design.
